2. **Filtering**: Filtered entries to include only those where level is `ERROR` or `CRITICAL` (case-insensitive).

4. **Message & Exception Extraction**: Extracted the message portion following `<service>: ` and retrieved the last line of any associated traceback (or `null` if no traceback was present).
5. **Repeat Count & Aggregation**: Accumulated repeat counts from `-- last message repeated N times --` lines following entries and summed total counts per service into `counts_by_service`.
